what: Best Buy is the largest consumer electronics retailer in the United States. It sells computers, televisions, appliances and phones through about 1,000 stores and online, and provides installation and repair through its Geek Squad.
customers: American and Canadian households buying electronics and appliances, plus small businesses.
money: televisions, audio, large and small appliances
Geek Squad support, installation and memberships
moat: Physical stores where customers can see expensive items before buying, plus installation and repair services that online sellers cannot match.
risks: Revenue was flat last year and has fallen about 3% a year over three years
Operating margin of about 3% is thin
Tariffs raise the cost of imported electronics
Analyst targets imply the shares are above fair value
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 15% with a dividend yield near 4%
An ageing installed base of pandemic-era devices is due for replacement
Membership and services revenue is more profitable and more stable than hardware
watch: Comparable sales and the mix of services revenue.
